title: Just Enough MC
description: This modpack is neither overly complex or tedious, nor is it just a vanilla plus survival modpack. If you're tired of playing vanilla and don't want to dive into those complicated large-scale modpacks, give this one a try. You'll find plenty of enjoyment
body:
**Welcome!**
---
This is a modpack that include many vanilla enhancement mods.

Tired of vanilla but don’t want to deal with those 300+ mod packs that take 10 minutes to load?

This pack is the sweet spot. It's a vanilla ++ modpack.It keeps the original Minecraft feel while adding just enough to make survival fresh again.（although there are some mods that change vanilla a lot）


**What's in the pack?**
- **Core Optimization**: Includes modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight for smooth gameplay on low-end devices
- **Quality of Life**: Adds QoL features like J
- REI/EMI, Jade, and Mouse Tweaks without changing vanilla gameplay a lot
  
**Why choose this pack?**
- **No bloat**: There is nothing superfluous, unilateral.It's perfect for players who want vanilla feel with better experience
- **Regular updates**: Maintained with the latest mod versions and bug fixes
  
In this modpack,you can find many interesting things:

- backpacks
- guns
- some new tools and ores
- some backport mods
- many new foods
- more chests
- more redstone things
...

You can survive more diversified.

---
**You’ll like this if:**

· You’ve played every vanilla version

· You want more, but not everything

· You tried those 400‑mod packs and quit after an hour

We are trying to make this modpack better and better.
Please leave your valuable suggestions. We will do our best to implement them.
